The '''Tozeer system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Hunnoverrs sector/Legends|Hunnoverrs sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tozeer]].
